name: @nanobpm/agentic-cockpit
description: The visibility page (cockpit) for the Nano agentic protocol (ADR 0056, S8): a networks demand x supply matrix, missing-agent lights and diversity-SLO state from @nanobpm/agentic-demand, plus a drill-into-a-worker live terminal over the S5 relay with resume-from-offset. A framework-free, injection-based core that renders identically embedded (console App View) and standalone. Built on @nanobpm/agentic-protocol, @nanobpm/agentic-demand, @nanobpm/agentic-vocab and @nanobpm/agentic-relay.
